subject: Re: ACME Corp POC - scope change & re-baseline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: ACME POC — post-call recap & proposed success criteria

Hi Samir — great to chat earlier. Quick recap and next steps from today's discovery: 

1) Goal: Validate Redwood inference runtime on 2 Acme customer-facing flows (support summarization & search re-ranking) at 50 reqs/sec with 95th percentile latency < 250ms for short prompts.
2) Success criteria (proposed):
   - Summarization: average ROUGE-L >= 0.7 on the evaluation set you shared (sample set attached).
   - Re-ranking: NDCG@10 improvement >= 12% over baseline on pilot dataset.
   - Throughput/latency: sustained 50 rps with 95p latency < 250ms for sequences <= 512 tokens.
3) Evaluation plan: we run a 4-week POC (2-week ingest/validation + 2-week load/metrics window). Redwood provides a small dedicated pool + instrumentation; Acme provides evaluation dataset + 1 engineering point of contact.
4) Ownership: Marissa (Redwood) will lead onboarding and SOW, Neha (Redwood CS) will lead eval support, Samir/Leah (Acme) will own dataset and procurement.

Attachments: RDW_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (initial SOW), security_questionnaire_filled.pdf (SOC2 evidence summary).

Next steps:
- Samir: confirm dataset availability and legal/procurement timeline by 10/22.
- Marissa: submit final SOW + updated success criteria draft by 10/20 (attached).

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME POC — post-call recap & proposed success criteria

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap. A couple of notes from the Acme side after internal review: 

1) We'd like to add a small third use case (customer intent classification for chat routing) to the POC scope. It's lower latency but critical to our routing logic.
2) Procurement flagged that the 4-week window is tight if we add a use case; can we re-baseline to 6 weeks? The extra time will let us provide a larger labeled sample for the classification eval.
3) Also, Leah will be the procurement contact — she'll handle the SOW/e-signature.

Would you be able to update success criteria for the classification use case and send an updated SOW? If possible, include any impact to cost or infrastructure needed.

— Samir
Samir Gupta
Senior PM, Search & Assist | Acme Corp
samir.gupta@acmecorp.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@acmecorp.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-23T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME POC — scope addition & updated timeline (draft SOW attached)

Great — thanks for the quick feedback. We can absolutely add the intent-classification use case. Quick updates in the attached SOW (RDW_POC_Terms_v2.pdf):

- Timeline: move to a 6-week POC (Week 0: kickoff & data ingest, Weeks 1–2: validation & baseline, Weeks 3–4: model tuning + classification eval, Week 5: load/latency window, Week 6: wrap & handoff).
- Success criteria (new): intent classification accuracy >= 88% on the labeled test set OR F1 >= 0.86 (we can pick which metric you prefer).
- Infrastructure impact: small additional ingestion and labeling support; recommended dedicated pool scaled +1 (no additional infra beyond the reserved pool; cost delta noted in SOW summary).
- Ownership: Acme provides labeled classification dataset and a small mapping doc for labels; Redwood provides evaluation harness and metrics dashboard.

I've attached the updated SOW and highlighted the changes. Leah/Procurement — if these terms look OK, we can send via DocuSign; I've included a draft link in the footer.

Quick Q for Acme: is Nov 15 a feasible kickoff date if procurement signs by 11/05?

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
